summary: Windows reserved names like CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1 to COM9 and LPT1 to LPT9 can't be used as file or directory names, even with an extension.
questions: Can I name a file COM1.txt in an Ansible collection?

answer_card.title: Illegal filenames
answer_card.answer_md: Reserved: `CON`, `PRN`, `AUX`, `NUL`, `COM1` to `COM9`, `LPT1` to `LPT9`, with or without an extension. `folder/COM1.txt` is illegal; `folder/COM1-file.txt` is fine.
